title: Thank you so much @A.R.T. ❤️. I loved this show so much and it was so...
transcript: So I got this package from Black Swan. Now, they didn't tell me what they were sending, but just based on the size and shape, I have a pretty good guess. But only one way to find out. So let's open it together. Well, a little backstory. They reached out and wanted to send us something because I don't know how many of you were following our saga to get down there, but we got a flat tire like 20 minutes into the road trip. Almost didn't make it. My friend Ashley was driving us, and we had to call Triple A. We had to wait for Triple A. Then Ashley's sister was able to switch cars with us because the temporary tire that she had on her car couldn't make it all the way up to Boston. And we made it with like two minutes to spare. So they said that they wanted to send us something as like a thank you for making the trip up. Which is crazy cause they didn't cause the flat tire, but I thought that that was really sweet. Looks to be a show poster. Wait, I was not expecting it to be signed. Oh, my god. Look at how stunning that is. Wow, wow, wow. This is incredible. I wish I could tell you to go see Black Swan, but sadly it's closed now. But if it comes back in any capacity, this show is a must see. I did a whole Review for it if you're interested, I'll link it in the caption below. A gorgeous score by Dave Malloy, stunning direction and choreography from Sonia Taiya. Incredible cast. One of the most exciting new musicals that I've seen in a while, and I can't wait to see where it goes next. So thank you A R T. For the poster. This is really special.
classificationReason: Creator describes attending the show (made the trip to Boston, arrived with two minutes to spare), expresses clear opinion ('I loved this show so much', 'this show is a must'), even though the video's framing is an unboxing of a signed poster gifted by the production.
